Here is the complete worked solution following official CAPS marking guidelines (5 marks):

LHS = $\frac{1}{\cos \theta} - \frac{\cos \theta}{1 + \sin \theta}$\\ $= \frac{1 + \sin \theta - \cos^2 \theta}{\cos \theta(1 + \sin \theta)}$\\ $= \frac{1 + \sin \theta - (1 - \sin^2 \theta)}{\cos \theta(1 + \sin \theta)}$\\ $= \frac{1 + \sin \theta - 1 + \sin^2 \theta}{\cos \theta(1 + \sin \theta)}$\\ $= \frac{\sin \theta + \sin^2 \theta}{\cos \theta(1 + \sin \theta)}$\\ $= \frac{\sin \theta(1 + \sin \theta)}{\cos \theta(1 + \sin \theta)}$\\ $= \frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \tan \theta = \text{RHS}$
